lead: Zoya Akhtar is best known as an Indian film director, born on 9 January 1974 in Mumbai.
As of 2026, she is 52 years old, and her birth date places her under the Capricorn sign.
She is associated with work such as Luck by Chance, Gully Boy and Made in Heaven and has been recognised with the Filmfare Award for Best Director.
